question: Calculate the chi-square statistic to assess the association between histological types and the presence of CDH1 gene mutations in female BRCA patients from the PanCancer Atlas, excluding categories with marginal totals less than or equal to 10, and only focusing on patients with known histological types and consider only reliable mutation entries.

m as (select distinct "ParticipantBarcode" pid from pancancer_atlas_mutation_data where "Hugo_Symbol"='CDH1' and "FILTER"='PASS'),
d as (select p.ht, (m.pid is not null) mut from p left join m using(pid)),
g as (select h.ht, x.mut, (select count(*) from d where d.ht=h.ht and d.mut=x.mut) o from (select distinct ht from d) h cross join (values(true),(false)) x(mut)),
r1 as (select ht from g group by ht having sum(o)>10),
g1 as (select * from g where ht in (select ht from r1)),
c1 as (select mut from g1 group by mut having sum(o)>10),
k as (select * from g1 where mut in (select mut from c1)),
t as (select k.*, sum(o) over (partition by ht) rt, sum(o) over (partition by mut) ct, sum(o) over () gt from k)
select sum(power(o - rt*ct/gt,2)/(rt*ct/gt)) chi_square from t

 SELECT substring("Patents_info" from '([A-Z]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9]+)\.?\s*$') pn FROM patents_publicationinfo
 WHERE "Patents_info" LIKE '%UNIV CALIFORNIA%' AND coalesce(substring("Patents_info" from '^(.*?) holds the [A-Z]{2} (?:patent )?(?:application|filing) \('),
                 substring("Patents_info" from '(?:owned by|assigned to|held by|belonging to) (.*?)(?: and has|, with) (?:publication|pub\.) (?:number|no\.)'))='UNIV CALIFORNIA'),

hit AS (SELECT DISTINCT cit.id FROM cit JOIN uc ON uc.pn=cit.cited),
citing AS (SELECT coalesce(substring(t."Patents_info" from '^(.*?) holds the [A-Z]{2} (?:patent )?(?:application|filing) \('),
                 substring(t."Patents_info" from '(?:owned by|assigned to|held by|belonging to) (.*?)(?: and has|, with) (?:publication|pub\.) (?:number|no\.)')) asg, t.cpc
  FROM hit h JOIN patents_publicationinfo t ON t.ctid=h.id),
sub AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.asg, left(e->>'code',4) sc FROM citing c, jsonb_array_elements(c.cpc::jsonb) e
  WHERE (e->>'first')::boolean AND c.asg<>'UNIV CALIFORNIA' AND c.asg<>'[]')

WITH r AS (

  CASE WHEN date ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$' THEN to_timestamp(date,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
       WHEN date ~ '^\d{1,2} [A-Za-z]{3} \d{4}, \d{2}:\d{2}$' THEN to_timestamp(date,'DD Mon YYYY, HH24:MI')
       WHEN date ~ '^[A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4} at \d{1,2}:\d{2} [AP]M$' THEN to_timestamp(date,'FMMonth DD, YYYY at HH12:MI AM') END ts
 FROM yelp_review),
top AS (
 SELECT business_ref, avg(rating) avg_rating FROM r
 WHERE ts >= '2016-01-01' AND ts < '2016-07-01'
 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=5 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1),
b AS (
 SELECT b.business_id, b.name, t.avg_rating,
   substring(b.description from '[A-Z]{2}\M,?(.*)$') AS tail
 FROM top t JOIN yelp_business b ON b.business_id = replace(t.business_ref,'businessref_','businessid_'))
SELECT b.name, round(b.avg_rating,2) AS avg_rating,

FROM b
